stimulus.alt: Shift-handoff diagram showing outgoing preparation, a written record, two-way exchange, incoming cross-check, clarification, and clear ownership of unresolved actions.
stimulus.caption: Use the handoff model to compare passive information transfer with a two-way transfer that supports clarification and cross-checking.

stem: What makes a two-way handoff stronger than sending a written note alone?
choices: The incoming person can clarify, confirm ownership, and cross-check critical conditions rather than only receive information
Verbal communication removes the need for records
Two-way handoff allows the outgoing worker to transfer responsibility for undocumented work
rationale: Human-factors guidance supports preparation, written and verbal exchange, questions, and cross-checking for continuity of important information.
